core_loop: OWNEX canonical loop: DISCOVER → EVALUATE → PREPARE → EXECUTE → VERIFY → EARN → LEARN

pulse.description: Source health, feed ingestion, deduplication, freshness, opportunity discovery
pulse.integration_bundle_ref: §9: Pulse → DISCOVER: source health, feed ingestion, deduplication, freshness, opportunity discovery
ownex_implementation: Daily Brief generation with all 5 source categories
Source status monitoring via /api/agent-bounties/sources endpoint
Feed ingestion from registered sources (Pulse cycle every 30 min proposal)
Deduplication of identical opportunities across sources
Freshness tracking: last_checked, last_verified timestamps
Opportunity discovery: present users with newly available sources
Pulse polling policy: configurable per source, 30-min cycle proposed (not universal default)
Prefer webhooks or official feeds when available; otherwise per-source intervals
Backoff, caching, rate limits, jitter, budgets, stale-data detection
User-configurable pause controls

source_health.agenthansa: PAUSED - flagged as fake platform (Oct 2026 research)
source_health.opire: ACTIVE - registered, conditional Argentina, mixed receipts

forge.description: Scoring, eligibility, work preparation, sandboxing, human gates, execution tracking
forge.integration_bundle_ref: §9: Forge → EVALUATE / PREPARE / EXECUTE: scoring, eligibility, work preparation, sandboxing, human gates, execution tracking
ownex_implementation: Opportunity scoring model across 12 dimensions (not summed, displayed separately)
Argentina eligibility filtering per user preferences
Beginner accessibility assessment (0-5 score)
Work preparation: draft PRs, evidence collection, checklists
Human approval gates for external submissions (EXECUTE_HUMAN_APPROVAL capability state)
Sandboxed workspaces for task preparation
Execution tracking: submissions, merge/acceptance, awards
Per-source performance record based on user's verified activity
Adapters map provider contracts into canonical source/opportunity contracts
No 85 bespoke engines - each source chooses ONE capability state
MANUAL_ONLY: display official link, no automation
PREPARE_ASSISTED: drafts, code workspaces, checklists without submission
EXECUTE_HUMAN_APPROVAL: human approves claim, bid, PR, report, transaction
AUTO_REVERSIBLE: low-risk reversible actions only

source_scoring.taskbounty: 12-dim score: argentina=1, beginner=1, demand=1, payout=2, recurrence=1, competition=3, skill=0, auto=0, fees=0, custody=0, confidence=1
source_scoring.github_bounties: 12-dim score: argentina=3, beginner=2, demand=2, payout=3, recurrence=3, competition=3, skill=0, auto=1, fees=2, custody=1, confidence=3
source_scoring.agenthansa: 12-dim score: argentina=3, beginner=2, demand=2, payout=3, recurrence=3, competition=3, skill=0, auto=1, fees=2, custody=1, confidence=3 (FLAGGED: fake platform)
source_scoring.opire: 12-dim score: argentina=1, beginner=1, demand=2, payout=0, recurrence=1, competition=1, skill=0, auto=1, fees=2, custody=0, confidence=3
source_scoring.bugbounty: 12-dim score: argentina=1, beginner=1, demand=1, payout=0, recurrence=1, competition=1, skill=2, auto=2, fees=0, custody=1, confidence=1

revenue.description: Award and payment reconciliation, actual receipts, fees, profitability, source-performance feedback
revenue.integration_bundle_ref: §9: Revenue → VERIFY / EARN / LEARN: award and payment reconciliation, actual receipts, fees, profitability, source-performance feedback
ownex_implementation: Revenue truth and reconciliation with strict separation of advertised vs observed vs received
Advertised maximum reward kept separate from typical observed reward
Estimated opportunity value never summed with best-case maximums across platforms
Only confirmed receipts with supporting evidence increase verified received income
A bounty listing, API call forecast, grant application, accepted task, wallet balance estimate, or pending payout must NOT be recorded as collected income
RevenueEvents with provenance and timestamps, avoiding double-counting across opportunity/wallet/payout-provider/off-ramp
Fee, gas, taxes, refunds, and losses tracked separately
Per-source performance record based on user's own verified activity (not aggregated totals)
Show separate: available reward pools vs user's earned vs pending vs received vs withdrawn
Daily Brief includes: findings (total/confirmed/pending), reports this month, targets active
Revenue Rule compliance: no feature enters roadmap without increasing detection, evidence quality, acceptance probability, or system learning

revenue_dimensions.advertised_maximum_reward: Shown separately, never treated as expected income
revenue_dimensions.typical_or_observed_reward: Actual observed payouts with evidence grade
revenue_dimensions.estimated_opportunity_value: Separate dimension, not summed across platforms
revenue_dimensions.award_approved: Only with sufficient evidence grade (A or B)

source_revenue.taskbounty: Theoretically possible with evidence; USD route to ARS pending verification
source_revenue.github_bounties: No observed receipts; Argentina payout route not verified
source_revenue.agenthansa: No observed receipts; Argentina payout route not verified (also fake platform)
source_revenue.opire: Uncorroborated; USD route to ARS pending verification (mixed receipts evidence)
source_revenue.bugbounty: Theoretically possible with evidence; USD route to ARS pending verification

vault.description: Wallet references, balances, supported networks, signing requests, payout-route metadata, user-approved financial actions. Not autonomous treasury or custodian.
vault.integration_bundle_ref: §9: Vault → security/infrastructure capability for wallet references, balances, supported networks, signing requests, payout-route metadata, and user-approved financial actions. It is not an autonomous treasury or custodian.
ownex_implementation: Wallet references by network: Base (USDC), Solana (USDC/SOL), XDC, Optimism (OP)
Balance tracking per wallet/network (informational only, not custodial)
Supported networks per source (documented, not recommended/endorsed)
Signing requests: user-explicit approval required, never auto-sign
Payout-route metadata: documented routes with verification status
User-approved financial actions: each transfer/swap/bridge requires explicit human approval
NOT an autonomous treasury or custodian - OWNEX never holds user funds
Never store seed phrases or private keys in application configuration, logs, source code, database backups, or GitHub
Chain ID, token contract, destination, amount, fees, and simulation/quote evidence required before approval
User-controlled wallets preferred; external key custody only, never stored in OWNEX
